scripts.dev:api: cd apps/api && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8888 --reload
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter documind-web lint && cd apps/api && uv run ruff check .
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter documind-web typecheck && cd apps/api && uv run mypy app
scripts.test: cd apps/api && uv run pytest -q && pnpm --filter documind-web typecheck
